units.reason: New test only; it adds coverage and cannot change production behavior.
units.headline: New test: evicted selected series record survives WAL checkpoint
units.summary: Adds a test that evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces WAL truncation at mint 150 until a checkpoint exists, and asserts the evicted series' record is still in the checkpoint. It is test-only and mirrors the existing CompactStaleHead variant, so a short read is enough.

risk_signals: eviction boundary changed from exclusive to inclusive
units.reason: Changes the early-return boundary and generalizes eviction via a predicate, which changes which series get deleted from the head and WAL.
units.headline: Generic series truncation with predicate; maxt bound now inclusive
units.summary: Replaces truncateStaleSeries' body with a generic truncateSeries that takes a shouldEvict predicate, returns the evicted count, and now proceeds when head MinTime == maxt (previously skipped). This also changes CompactStaleHead, which now goes through the same path, so a head holding a single timestamp can now be evicted.
focus: Every caller (compactHeadViewLocked for stale and selected paths) passes an inclusive maxt, i.e. the highest persisted sample timestamp, not the exclusive block end
With the >= to > change, series whose only samples are at maxt were actually written to the block before being evicted
WAL tombstones written for deleted refs cover the right interval so replay drops exactly the evicted data

units.reason: Changes head series and stale-series counter accounting during eviction, which feeds metrics and later decisions.
units.headline: Head.gcSeries decrements stale counter only for actually stale series
units.summary: Renames gcStaleSeries to gcSeries, passes the eviction predicate through, and decrements numStaleSeries by the count of deleted series that were stale instead of by all deleted series. Without this, evicting non-stale selected series would underflow the uint64 stale counter.
focus: numStaleSeries stays consistent with the append-path increments/decrements when a deleted series' stale state is judged at deletion time under the series lock

units.reason: Replaces the hardcoded staleness check with a caller-supplied predicate, deciding which in-memory series are deleted.
units.headline: stripeSeries eviction uses caller predicate, counts stale deletions
units.summary: The per-series staleness check is replaced by shouldEvict(series), so callers can evict non-stale series; the function also returns how many deleted series were stale. Which series get dropped from the head now depends on the predicates in truncateStaleSeries and truncateSelectedSeries.
focus: shouldEvict (which calls hasAppendIDAbove, documented 'Must be called with s.Lock held') runs inside the series lock in check
The maxTime <= maxt and pending-commit safety checks still run before shouldEvict for the selected-series path
isStaleSeries is evaluated on the same locked state used by the predicate
